description: Evidence-driven, falsification-first investigation for connection-reset-style bugs: WebSocket/SSE drops at a suspiciously exact interval, ECONNRESET/HTTP-2 RST_STREAM, CDN/proxy/CGNAT idle timeouts, TLS certificate-verification errors, DB connection-pool exhaustion ("pool at capacity" despite repeated pool-size bumps), cron/job-scheduler intermittent failures, and thread-pool or queue-worker exhaustion. Use whenever a fix is about to be applied on a guess, or a recurring incident is about to be closed without a falsified hypothesis. Demands a concrete artifact before accepting a theory, requires each hypothesis to name its falsifier, runs layered/boundary isolation -- the same request or job through paths differing by one hop -- instead of stacking assumptions, and blocks shipping a fix without an adversarial second opinion. Treats "just restart it" / "bump the pool size" / "add a retry" as relief to interrogate, not a diagnosis, unless logged as a deliberate stabilization call.
